question: To what kind of person must this teaching be given, given the conditions of fitness stated?
premises: The teaching is to be given.
It is to be given to one endowed with all states.
It is to be given to one of resolved mind.
inference: This teaching is to be given to one who is endowed with all states and of resolved mind.
